title: Evaluating Explainable AI on a Multi-Modal Medical Imaging Task: Can Existing Algorithms Fulfill Clinical Requirements?
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of Explainable AI (XAI) algorithms in a medical context, assessing metrics like faithfulness and plausibility. While operating in an ethically-sensitive domain, it does not evaluate or benchmark ethical, moral, or religious principles themselves. Mentions of ethics are limited to standard procedure (e.g., Research Ethics Board approval) or peripheral user study options, which are not a core component of the research.
